# Agent Journal (structured notes)

## Findings
- Issue #26208 (twinx + stackplot wipes ax1.dataLim) root cause: `ax2.plot(...)` with string x-data → category converter `default_units` → `axis.set_units` → `'units'` callback → `ax1._unit_change_handler` → `ax1.relim()` → `ax1.dataLim.set_points(Bbox.null())`. stackplot's PolyCollections are not re-added by relim, so ax1's dataLim becomes null (`inf/-inf`).
- Fix (matches upstream commit 5570743e72, PR #26208, blob 5203e3232c..0d6e5d1677): in `twinx()` add `ax2.xaxis.units = self.xaxis.units`; in `twiny()` add `ax2.yaxis.units = self.yaxis.units` — both in lib/matplotlib/axes/_base.py. With units shared, `update_units` sees `self.units is not None` and never calls `set_units`, so the 'units' callback never fires on ax1.
- Regression test `test_twin_units` (parametrized x/y) added to lib/matplotlib/tests/test_axes.py after `test_twinx_cla`, copied from upstream commit 5570743e72.
- Verification: repro.py prints expected `[-22.71770833 26.585]` after ax2.plot; 6/6 twin* tests pass; full test_axes.py failure set identical before/after fix (124 pre-existing, all freetype-2.13.2-vs-2.6.1 image comparisons + numpy-2 timedelta deprecation).

## Leads
- Environment quirks (see memory): campaign venv .pth shim imports matplotlib from the 20488 checkout; run26208.py strips those paths, re-seeds the mpl_toolkits namespace (repo's lib/mpl_toolkits has no __init__.py, so dist-packages' regular package would win) and shims np.row_stack→np.vstack (numpy 2 removed the alias).
- Build recipe for this tree: PYTHONPATH=C:/Windows/Temp/mplbuild (vendored pybind11 2.13.6) + mplsetup.cfg `[libs] system_freetype=True system_qhull=True`, then build_driver.py (setup.py build_ext --inplace). build_driver.py hardcodes its chdir target — fix it per checkout.

## Decisions
- Fixed in source only (lib/matplotlib), never in tests, per TASK.md; the added test is a regression test, not a fix.
